# mapbox sprites

Sprites API

The sprite sheet a style draws its icons from, and the individual icons in it.

5 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox sprites delete

Delete image from a sprite

Remove a single image from a style's sprite.

`DELETE https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/sprite/{icon_name}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `icon-name` | `ICON_NAME` | yes | string |  | URL-encoded name of the sprite image. Sent in the request path. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox sprites delete --username USERNAME STYLE_ID ICON_NAME
```

### mapbox sprites delete-batch

Delete multiple images from a sprite

Batch remove images from a style's sprite. The request body must be a
JSON array of image name strings. Maximum 150 image names per request.

`DELETE https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/sprite`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `data` | `--data DATA` `-d` | yes | string |  | Request body as a JSON string, or `@<path>` to read a file and `@-` to read stdin. Sent in the request body. Sent as `application/json`. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox sprites delete-batch --username USERNAME STYLE_ID --data '{}'
```

### mapbox sprites get-json

Retrieve sprite JSON

Fetch sprite JSON metadata containing image coordinates and dimensions.
Immutable sprite URLs enable long caching.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/sprite`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox sprites get-json --username USERNAME STYLE_ID
```

### mapbox sprites upload

Add image to a sprite

Insert a single SVG image into a style's sprite. Send raw SVG data in
the request body — form encoding is not supported.

Limits:
- Images can be up to 512 pixels in each dimension
- Each image must be smaller than 400 KB
- Image names limited to 255 characters
- Sprites can contain up to 1,000 images
- Must be SVG format

`PUT https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/sprite/{icon_name}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `icon-name` | `ICON_NAME` | yes | string |  | URL-encoded name of the sprite image. Sent in the request path. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `file` | `--file PATH` | yes | path |  | File whose bytes are sent as the request body (image/svg+xml). Sent in the request body. Sent as `image/svg+xml`. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox sprites upload --username USERNAME STYLE_ID ICON_NAME --file PATH
```

### mapbox sprites upload-batch

Add multiple images to a sprite

Batch add up to 25 SVG images to a style's sprite via multipart form data.
Images must be submitted under the `images` field.

Limits:
- Maximum 25 images per request
- Maximum 100 KB per image
- Images must be SVG format

`POST https://api.mapbox.com/styles/v1/{username}/{style_id}/sprite`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style-id` | `STYLE_ID` | yes | string |  | Unique identifier for the style. Sent in the request path. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `file` | `--file PATH` | yes | path |  | File to upload, repeatable, sent as multipart field `images`. Sent in the request body. Sent as `multipart/form-data`. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{username}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox sprites upload-batch --username USERNAME STYLE_ID --file PATH
```
